reuse.why: Uses the existing getCategoriesWithGroupHidden, isWrittenByMonthAction, toAverageBudgetAmount, getSheetValue and batchMessages, and registers via the same mutator(undoable(...)) wrapper.

duplication.why: No decision logic is copied; only the per-category loop skeleton shared by all month actions is repeated, as the tree already does for each action.

placement.why: The action sits in budget/actions.ts beside the other month-wide actions and the handler is registered in budget/app.ts like its siblings.

scope.why: Only the new action, its handler registration and tests are added.

maintainability.why: Easy to own since category selection and sign conversion come from the shared helpers; reusing toAverageBudgetAmount for a non-average amount is slightly misleading by name.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Category selection goes through isWrittenByMonthAction and the sign through toAverageBudgetAmount.
